        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous Materials",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous Materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Some ores, dusts and chemicals are hazardous and can cause negative effects or even kill you if they are carried in your inventory. When carried, they are displayed on screen with a Status Effect. Certain equipment such as masks, gloves, and the hazardous material suit can be used to counter these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "All of the effects",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Arsenicosis - Asbestosis - Berylliosis - Carbon Monoxide poisoning - Carcinogens - Chemical burns - Irritants - Methanol poisoning - Nauseating chemicals - Poisonous materials - Radioactive materials - Silicosis The next page will provide information on how to deal with these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prevention and Cures",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Rocks? - Containers - The Face Mask - The Rubber Gloves - The Hazmat Suit - Pills, Tablets and Salvos - The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill - The Unthinkable...",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rocks!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The easiest way to prevent hazardous effects is to not pick up the dangerous items at all. Filling your inventory with Rocks, for example, will let you pick and choose which items you want to pick up, letting you deal with the hazardous ones later.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous materials only deal damage while they are in your inventory, but that doesn't apply to other containers! Hazardous materials will not deal damage while they are in another container such as a Backpack or Vessel. Right-clicking while holding a vessel will allow direct transfer of its contents to and from containers.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Face Mask",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask provides protection from any Inhalation hazards, such as Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rubber gloves",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Rubber gloves can either be made from Leather and Latex, or out of Rubber Sheets. They provide protection from any Skin Contact hazards, such as Beryllium Dust.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "First, knap the leather into mittens.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Mittens are then soaked in Vinegar, a mixture of fruit and alcohol.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prepared leather gloves are then heated in a vat with Vulcanized Latex, one step away from rubber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Finally, the latex-soaked gloves are heated in an Oven.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Hazmat Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "A completed Hazmat suit provides immunity from every hazard, even radiation. It is made in an LV Assembler from Polyethylene and Polyvinyl Chloride. Fun fact! You can also look up #ppe_armor in JEI for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some Medicines that can help you recover. Basic Pills are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with Negative Side Effects. Tablets and Salvos are more effective and have less side effects, but they require LV equipment and more advanced resources to make.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "This is The Ultimate cure for ALL the hazards and the ONLY effective cure to Radiation. However, it is also the most Expensive and Difficult to make, requiring HV tier equipment and advanced materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea. If you don't have access to Wool or String, you can also make a Thatch Bed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Arsenicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Arsenic from its dust, vapor or Realgar. It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Asbestosis is an illness caused by inhaling Asbestos dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Asbestosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Berylliosis is an illness caused by skin contact with Beryllium dust or Liquid Beryllium. At first it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it kills you. Gloves and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Berylliosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning is an illness caused by inhaling Carbon Monoxide gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Carbon Monoxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carcinogens are substances that cause Cancer. They include Chromium Dust aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. Carcinogens don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes Death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the Gloves protect from contact with Chromium Dust. The Hazmat Suit protects from both. In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some Medicines to Prevent any possible damage.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain Gases, Acids, Bases or Dusts. Exposure causes Weakness. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from everything.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Irritation is caused by inhalation of Ammonium Formate or skin contact with Chromite Dust. Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts Damaging Randomly. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from both.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning is caused by inhalation of Methanol. It causes a strong Blindness effect. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protects from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals, such as Butyraldehyde, are substances that cause Nausea when inhaled. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protect from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Poisonous materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "There are two types of Poisonous materials. Weak include Lead Dust, while the stronger poisons include Nitrogen Dioxide. Weak poisons cause a Progressively Worsening Poison effect, while Regular poisons cause Weakness and a Stronger Poison effect. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from any contact.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Most Radioactive substances like Uranium 238 you will only meet at EV tier or above. They will Permanently Irradiate you. Small exposure causes glowing, but prolonged contact triggers a quick Death. We know it looks tasty and has a billion calories, but PLEASE DO NOT EAT URANIUM!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Only the Hazmat Suit, as well as some advanced armors provide full protection from radiation. In the case you do get irradiated, only the RadAwayᵗᵐ pill can cure you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Silicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Silicon Dioxide Dust. Exposure causes a Reduction in both Health and the Air Supply you have while diving Under Water. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from inhalation of silicon dioxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },

          "text": "Wild Crops can be found scattered around the world, growing in small patches. They can be harvested for food and seeds, which can then be cultivated themselves in the not-wild form. Harvesting wild crops can be done with your fists, or with a Knife or other sharp tool. When broken, they will drop Seeds and some Products.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",

        {

          "text": "An example of a wild crop, in this case Wheat.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Wild Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 20,
          "count": 12
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/wild_crops",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/wild_crops.json",
          "text": "Every crop that can be cultivated can also be found in the wild. Wild crops will look similar to their cultivated counterparts, but are more hidden within the grass. Wild crops are only mature from June to October. Otherwise, they appear dead until the next Summer.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Wild Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 20,
          "count": 12
        },
        {

          "text": "All different varieties of wild crop",

          "label": "Wild Crops",
          "item_ref_count": 20,

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/the_world/wild_crops.json",
          "text": "Wild crops will spawn in climates near where the crop itself can be cultivated, so if looking for a specific crop, look in the climate where the crop can be cultivated.         {

          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This quest chapter gives you a lot, (and we do mean a lot) of tips on how to survive and thrive.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Each quest branch representing major mods in TerraFirmaGreg, with tips to make the most out of them. None of these quests are necessary for progression, although some may be locked behind main questline tasks.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Dear God that's a lot of branches...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tips and Tricks be here!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Firmalife is a mod all about extending the agricultural and gastronomic experience in TerraFirmaCraft, with touches of miscellaneous features. Includes things such as decorations, more preservation methods, new foods, bees and a plethora of useful gadgets!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Thrive in TerraFirmaCraft",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "ArborFirmaCraft is a mod that adds multiple new trees to TFG: some are variants of existing TFC trees, such as Ancient Kapok, while others are completely new, such as the Baobab and Hevea. Some of the plank and log textures of these trees may remind you of vanilla tree colors...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This section will go over Tree Tapping.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "As a bonus, all ArborFirmaCraft woods are compatible with FirmaLife, and Firma:Civ, we made sure of it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "kind": "quest_node",

          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft is one of the main mods in TerraFirmaGreg. This branch mostly focuses on some of its survival features and other Add-Ons the modpack has, such as Aged Alcohol and Canes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To begin tapping trees, you'll need to forge a Tree Tap from working Copper Ingots on an Anvil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The process of tapping requires finding a suitable tree, a dedicated Tapping Index in the ArborFirmaCraft Field Guide section will tell you how to find these trees. There's also the Tapping Trees entry, which can be used to learn how to actually tap them.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Utilizing the Vacuum Chamber and some additional heating, you can process Latex from various trees into Raw Rubber Pulp through a specific process. You can then smelt together 3 Raw Rubber Pulp with a bit of Sulfur Dust in an Alloy Smelter to create Rubber Ingots, perfect for insulating cables and very much necessary to advance in the Voltaic Age and beyond...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: As you progress, there will be several ways to make this process cheaper and easier. Keep checking EMI! You'll be using Rubber for a long time, so it's well worth automating.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sticky Resin can be utilized as slime balls in some recipes. It is also key in the production of Resin Circuits and Resistors, which you'll need a fair bit of to advance into the Low Voltage age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        {

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Syrup Trees can be found in temperate areas of the world that receive moderate amounts of rainfall. It can be tapped to obtain Syrup. Syrup can be used to create Tree Sugars, an alternative sugar among other uses.",

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tree Sugar is a sugar substitute, mostly used as a food ingredient.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To make it, you'll need to boil Tree Sap to get Concentrated Sap, then boil it again to get Syrup. Finally, use a workbench to turn a Bucket of Syrup into Tree sugar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "If you have advanced to the MV age, you can make a Refrigerator, consuming power in exchange for the best universal food preservation trait for all food items. This includes raw and cooked food, and combined foods like sandwiches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This thing may be overpowered",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Beekeeping has a plethora of uses. Not only do bees fertilize nearby crops (assuming you have the correct trait), you will be able to obtain useful resources such as Wax and Honey. Breed bees to achieve better stats.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide offers an extensive explanation of all beekeeping mechanics.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",

        },

          "kind": "quest_node",

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Bees don't like it when people disrupt them and harvest their precious honey and wax or move their frames around. There are three ways to do it safely:",

          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32

          "text": "Each quest branch representing major mods in TerraFirmaGreg, with tips to make the most out of them. None of these quests are necessary for progression, although some may be locked behind main questline tasks.",

          "label": "queststfc_tips",

        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Firmalife is a mod all about extending the agricultural and gastronomic experience in TerraFirmaCraft, with touches of miscellaneous features. Includes things such as decorations, more preservation methods, new foods, bees and a plethora of useful gadgets!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Thrive in TerraFirmaCraft",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "ArborFirmaCraft is a mod that adds multiple new trees to TFG: some are variants of existing TFC trees, such as Ancient Kapok, while others are completely new, such as the Baobab and Hevea. Some of the plank and log textures of these trees may remind you of vanilla tree colors...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This section will go over Tree Tapping.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "As a bonus, all ArborFirmaCraft woods are compatible with FirmaLife, and Firma:Civ, we made sure of it!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/tapping_index",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Harvesting the Life-blood of Trees",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Deep, DEEP underground, past the Bedrock, you'll find The Beneath, a complex network of huge caves filled with dangers and strange flora and fauna. While The Beneath is completely optional, it contains a lot of resources as well as some quality of life improvements.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:beneath/beneath",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Journey to the Center of the Earth",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The Beneath",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft is one of the main mods in TerraFirmaGreg. This branch mostly focuses on some of its survival features and other Add-Ons the modpack has, such as Aged Alcohol and Canes.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The other two thirds of the modpack's name",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "TerraFirmaCraft Addons",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To begin tapping trees, you'll need to forge a Tree Tap from working Copper Ingots on an Anvil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The process of tapping requires finding a suitable tree, a dedicated Tapping Index in the ArborFirmaCraft Field Guide section will tell you how to find these trees. There's also the Tapping Trees entry, which can be used to learn how to actually tap them.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/tree_tapping",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Now with less jank!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Utilizing the Vacuum Chamber and some additional heating, you can process Latex from various trees into Raw Rubber Pulp through a specific process. You can then smelt together 3 Raw Rubber Pulp with a bit of Sulfur Dust in an Alloy Smelter to create Rubber Ingots, perfect for insulating cables and very much necessary to advance in the Voltaic Age and beyond...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tip: As you progress, there will be several ways to make this process cheaper and easier. Keep checking EMI! You'll be using Rubber for a long time, so it's well worth automating.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Insulate them cables",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Rubber Ingot",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sticky Resin can be utilized as slime balls in some recipes. It is also key in the production of Resin Circuits and Resistors, which you'll need a fair bit of to advance into the Low Voltage age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To make sticky resin, you need to boil either Latex or Conifer Pitch in a Vat mixed with Wood Ash.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "No, it's not Rosin",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sticky Resin",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Latex Trees can be found in temperate areas of the world that receive large amounts of rainfall. It can be tapped to obtain Latex, used to create both Sticky Resin, and Vulcanized Latex. The latter is used to produce Rubber and Rubber Gloves, which protect you from poisonous materials on contact.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to look at a block that has the tag #tfg:latex_logs. You can use EMI to learn which blocks have this tag by searching with that hashtag.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/making_rubber",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Seek for the Tropics",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "ftbfiltersystem:item_tag(tfg:latex_logs)",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Any #tfg:latex_logs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Latex Trees",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Syrup Trees can be found in temperate areas of the world that receive moderate amounts of rainfall. It can be tapped to obtain Syrup. Syrup can be used to create Tree Sugars, an alternative sugar among other uses.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To complete this quest, you need to look at a block that has the tag #tfg:syrup_logs. You can use EMI to learn which blocks have this tag.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:arborfirmacraft/making_syrups",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Diabetes is Skyrocketing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "{quests.tasktype.lookat} #tfg:syrup_logs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "#tfg:syrup_logs",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Syrup Trees",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tree Sugar is a sugar substitute, mostly used as a food ingredient.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "To make it, you'll need to boil Tree Sap to get Concentrated Sap, then boil it again to get Syrup. Finally, use a workbench to turn a Bucket of Syrup into Tree sugar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Keep in mind that all these boiling processes require a stick in the Vat or pot.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Sweet!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(afc:maple_sugar)item(afc:birch_sugar))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Maple or Birch Sugar",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Tree Sugar",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "If you have advanced to the MV age, you can make a Refrigerator, consuming power in exchange for the best universal food preservation trait for all food items. This includes raw and cooked food, and combined foods like sandwiches.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "This thing may be overpowered",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Beekeeping has a plethora of uses. Not only do bees fertilize nearby crops (assuming you have the correct trait), you will be able to obtain useful resources such as Wax and Honey. Breed bees to achieve better stats.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide offers an extensive explanation of all beekeeping mechanics.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:firmalife/beekeeping",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "They're so small now...",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Click here to complete this quest/task",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/queststfc_tips",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/queststfc_tips.snbt",
          "text": "Bees don't like it when people disrupt them and harvest their precious honey and wax or move their frames around. There are three ways to do it safely:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "queststfc_tips",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "ore_processing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "An important part of GregTech is its Ore Processing Mechanics, but it can get pretty complicated, so this chapter is here to help!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "To start with, you should be aware of the Ore Processing Diagram tab in EMI - Press the Show Uses key (default U) on any item related to ore processing and look for the tab with the vanilla Iron Ore icon. This diagram may look overwhelming at first, but we'll take it step by step.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "A major part of GregTech philosophy is that there's not just one way to solve a problem, but we've marked everything important with a star, so if you're completely lost, try following those!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "To Process, Ore Not To Process",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I agree to not just dump everything in a furnace",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to Ore Processing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "While looking at EMI, you've probably noticed that your Macerator or Millstone lists more outputs than what you're actually getting.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "GregTech doesn't communicate this very well, but these extra slots are only available in HV. Once you make it to that tier, the HV macerator becomes incredibly powerful, giving a huge amount of bonus byproducts from each ore.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I can get even more from my ores!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hv_macerator)item(greate:stainless_steel_crushing_wheel))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Either an HV Macerator or HS Crushing Wheels",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Crushing with byproducts",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Bathing certain ores in Mercury can give some other useful byproducts. Not all ores can be processed this way, but the ones that can, will get around a 70 percent chance of byproducts, compared to the 30 percent of the Ore Washer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",

          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "The quest below gives some examples of crushed ores which are good to process in Mercury.",

        {

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "text": "This... is a Bucket.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The final task in the Metallurgy Age is creating a Bucket. Unlike the wooden bucket and other fluid containers you've been using until now, the Bucket can be used to carry Lava and move around source blocks of other fluids.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Black Steel Anvil you'll now be able to work Black Steel Ingots into different items.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You've also now opened up a massive new section in the Early Automation chapter related to high pressure Steam Power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "From here, you can either dive straight into industrialization or finish up the last tier of anvils if you'd like. You can't avoid colored steel forever, though!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Steam power is within your grasp",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T5 Anvil: Black Steel",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "With the Steel Anvil, you'll be able to work Steel Ingots into different forms.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Steel tools and equipment have a significant boost over their bronze and wrought iron counterparts, so they're worth making if your existing ones are about to break. You'll be needing to create a lot of alloys soon, so some new mining equipment would be a wise investment.",

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        },
        {

          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T3 Anvil: Wrought Iron",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "To work metal into more than just double ingots, you'll need to use an anvil of the same tier or better. Working on an anvil can be a little bit complicated, but there's an entry in the TFG Tips section of the field guide that goes into more detail.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Bronze also marks the start of automation, where you'll begin to harness mechanical power!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Basic mechanical power starts here",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",

        {

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "T2 Anvil: Bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Obtain at least 14 Ingots of any Bronze type, then weld them together in the Copper Anvil.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Tier 2 Anvil can be made from Bismuth Bronze, Bronze or Black Bronze, but not a mixture of the three.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "I told you to get used to it",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
