        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Welding Bronze",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is a Multiblock from TerraFirmaCraft that allows you to create Wrought Iron. Melting iron in a forge will produce Cast Iron, which is brittle and nowhere near as strong or durable as Wrought Iron.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bloomery is expensive, so it will be worth investing some time into setting up automatic plate production and ore processing.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains a detailed entry on how the Bloomery works and the correct ratios of iron and fuel that it needs.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/bloomery",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Required if you seek the Iron Age.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Blast Furnace is a multiblock structure that allows you to create Pig Iron. Placing a combination of Iron, Flux and fuel (see the adjacent quest) inside the Blast Furnace produces Pig Iron, which can be worked into Steel.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "In order for the Blast Furnace to reach its required high temperatures, it will need its own Bellows, used to force air through a Tuyere which you place inside the blast furnace.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Field Guide contains an entry on how the Blast Furnace works and how to build one.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:tfg_tips/blast_furnace_tips",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Then I started Blastin'",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",

        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "{quests.tasktype.item.any} #tfc:tuyeres",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Blast Furnace",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "The Bellows is a device that can force extra air into a fire or forge in front of it, allowing the heat produced by the fuel inside to reach higher temperatures than usual, at the cost of fuel duration.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "These higher temperatures are required to fire pottery with charcoal or melt certain metals.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Coal and Coke can also reach higher temperatures without it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "tfc:field_guide tfc:mechanics/bellows",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Higher temperatures can be reached, at a small price.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Once you find Kaolin Clay, you should bring as much back as you can possibly carry! Unfortunately, only 20 percent of it will successfully cook into Kaolinite Powder, so it's recommended to bake it in situ with pit kilns, to save inventory space.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "After you craft the Crucible and the Blast Furnace, you won't need much more of it, but it's still a good idea to bring home more than you think you'll need, to avoid a repeat journey.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "P.S.: If you've found blood lilies but no clay, try digging down a little further! Sometimes it spawns a little underground.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Kaolin Trek: The Next Generation",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Kaolin Clay",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "one_started",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "Graphite spawns exclusively in flat, wide discs deep underground.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You will have to go exploring underground through the caves to try and spot some! Graphite veins can spawn in any stone type and also include Coal and Diamond. However, due to the depth of the veins, indicators likely will not appear on the surface. Tools such as a metal Shield, Digger Helmet, Propick, and Spyglass can also prove to be very useful!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/questsmetallurgy",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/questsmetallurgy.snbt",
          "text": "You mean I can't just rely on surface indicators?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "Congratulations on crafting the Bucket. The Metallurgy Age is officially over.",

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",

          "text": "To start with, you should be aware of the Ore Processing Diagram tab in EMI - Press the Show Uses key (default U) on any item related to ore processing and look for the tab with the vanilla Iron Ore icon. This diagram may look overwhelming at first, but we'll take it step by step.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "A major part of GregTech philosophy is that there's not just one way to solve a problem, but we've marked everything important with a star, so if you're completely lost, try following those!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "To Process, Ore Not To Process",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I agree to not just dump everything in a furnace",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Welcome to Ore Processing",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "While looking at EMI, you've probably noticed that your Macerator or Millstone lists more outputs than what you're actually getting.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "GregTech doesn't communicate this very well, but these extra slots are only available in HV. Once you make it to that tier, the HV macerator becomes incredibly powerful, giving a huge amount of bonus byproducts from each ore.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "I can get even more from my ores!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "or(item(gtceu:hv_macerator)item(greate:stainless_steel_crushing_wheel))",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Either an HV Macerator or HS Crushing Wheels",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Crushing with byproducts",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Bathing certain ores in Mercury can give some other useful byproducts. Not all ores can be processed this way, but the ones that can, will get around a 70 percent chance of byproducts, compared to the 30 percent of the Ore Washer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Mercury can be easily obtained from Redstone or Cinnabar.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "The quest below gives some examples of crushed ores which are good to process in Mercury.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Don't stick your finger in it",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Bathe them in Mercury",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Once you get to LV, you may be interested in using a Chemical Bath with Sodium persulfate to get some extra byproducts. Not all ores can be processed this way, but the ones that can, will get around a 70 percent chance of byproducts, compared to the 30 percent of the Ore Washer.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "Sodium persulfate can be a little annoying to mass produce, though if you want, Sea Water is a great starting point.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "The quest below gives some examples that might be worth the investment.",

          "label": "ore_processing",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "The Indium Line shouldn't be needed before IV, but it will require purified Sphalerite and Galena.",

        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "The Platinum Line will be your first real challenge to process, providing you with essential platinum-group metals: Platinum, Palladium, Ruthenium, Rhodium, Iridium, and Osmium.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "ore_processing",

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/ore_processing.snbt",
          "text": "While there's easier ways to obtain Platinum and Palladium, this line will be mandatory for accessing the others.",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {

          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/ore_processing",

        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Fluid Regulator is sort of the equivalent to a Robot Arm for Fluids.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It can transfer fluids, but has two useful modes:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",

          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "- Supply Exact will transfer the amount of specified Fluid per tick if available. No more, no less.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",

          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You won't need it much, because natively GT machines will fill only one slot with the Pump Cover",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A cover that you may not use much",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Fluid Regulator",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When placed on a machine, Robot Arms are a more configurable version of a Conveyor Module. They allow you to transfer items in specific batches, at specific rates, or keep a certain amount of items stocked.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Practical uses for the Robot Arm will be explained in future Quests as a tutorial.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: The functionalities provided by the Robot Arm work only if it is required to perform the operation.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "{@pagebreak}",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Lore: GregTech 5 had blocks such as the Buffer, Filter and Type Filter to allow fine control over items. In GTCE it's all been replaced by the almighty Robot Arm and various Filter Covers. Much more compact!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You're going to hate making these",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Robot Arm",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Less common as a component, but used in a number of critical machines.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When placed on a machine, conveyor modules will transfer items. You can configure them to import or export.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "They can also accept various Item Filters.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A crafting component, but also a cover!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Conveyor Module",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When placed on a machine, pumps will transfer fluid. You can configure them to import or export.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "It can accept a Fluid Filter.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Electric Pump",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A specialized motor needed to make certain machines.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "One of the more intricate crafting components, as it's made using a motor.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "A crafting component - did you expect anything fancier?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "LV Electric Piston",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Steam Turbine is most players' first LV generator, as you've already got steam production set up from your Steam machines.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "When provided Steam, the turbine will output EU at a ratio of 2 mB = 1 EU.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "One downside of steam is transporting it, and due to its lack of energy density, you'll need large or huge pipes to carry it around.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You may also consider upgrading to the Large Bronze Boiler once you start needing more power than what your single-block boilers can produce.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You must construct additional turbines",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The Steam Turbine",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "This questline serves as a quick guide to GregTech Amperage. As for Voltage mechanics, we'll go over those once you reach MV.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "TL;DR: For safety, match the Amperage limit of your Cables with the max amount of Amps provided by your Energy Producers.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Still confused? Check the GregTech Energy chapter for a full rundown on GregTech's electricity system!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Amps and You: a how-to",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "But what are Amps?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "one_completed",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Well... can you show us an MV Circuit as well?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Aluminium is the main ingredient for MV machinery. Get ready to need a lot of it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "The process of smelting Aluminium can be cut down by about a third with Nitrogen, which is obtained by centrifuging Air from a Gas Collector.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "You will still need MV Circuits in order to make MV machines!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "We're basically in MV now, right?",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Your first Aluminium Ingot",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Make some Battery Alloy, used for Battery Hulls.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Antimony is found in Stibnite, look through your TFC Field Guide for more information on where to find it.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Note: This quest does not contain functional Batteries - head downwards for that.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Batteries are great!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Battery Preparations!",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Covers are placed by right-clicking with Cover in hand on a face of a machine, and removed with a Crowbar (or by mining the machine, but that's way slower).",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Pretty much any GregTech Tile-Entity will accept Covers, even if they wouldn't provide any functionality.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "Opening a Cover is done by sneak-right-clicking it with an empty hand. You can also right-click with a Screwdriver, or sneak-right-click on another face using the grid.",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32
        },
        {
          "kind": "quest_node",
          "id": "pack:ftbquests/chapters/lv__low_voltage",
          "source": "file:minecraft/config/ftbquests/quests/chapters/lv__low_voltage.snbt",
          "text": "For Covers that transfer Items/Fluids, you will have a button to enable/disable other forms of transfer through the cover:",
          "key": "quest-snbt",
          "label": "lv__low_voltage",
          "item_ref_count": 32

        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous Materials",
          "key": "guide-page:name",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous Materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Some ores, dusts and chemicals are hazardous and can cause negative effects or even kill you if they are carried in your inventory. When carried, they are displayed on screen with a Status Effect. Certain equipment such as masks, gloves, and the hazardous material suit can be used to counter these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.0.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "All of the effects",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Arsenicosis - Asbestosis - Berylliosis - Carbon Monoxide poisoning - Carcinogens - Chemical burns - Irritants - Methanol poisoning - Nauseating chemicals - Poisonous materials - Radioactive materials - Silicosis The next page will provide information on how to deal with these effects.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.1.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prevention and Cures",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "- Rocks? - Containers - The Face Mask - The Rubber Gloves - The Hazmat Suit - Pills, Tablets and Salvos - The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill - The Unthinkable...",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.2.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rocks!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The easiest way to prevent hazardous effects is to not pick up the dangerous items at all. Filling your inventory with Rocks, for example, will let you pick and choose which items you want to pick up, letting you deal with the hazardous ones later.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.3.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Hazardous materials only deal damage while they are in your inventory, but that doesn't apply to other containers! Hazardous materials will not deal damage while they are in another container such as a Backpack or Vessel. Right-clicking while holding a vessel will allow direct transfer of its contents to and from containers.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.4.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Face Mask",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask provides protection from any Inhalation hazards, such as Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.5.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Rubber gloves",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Rubber gloves can either be made from Leather and Latex, or out of Rubber Sheets. They provide protection from any Skin Contact hazards, such as Beryllium Dust.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.6.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "First, knap the leather into mittens.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.7.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Mittens are then soaked in Vinegar, a mixture of fruit and alcohol.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.8.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Prepared leather gloves are then heated in a vat with Vulcanized Latex, one step away from rubber.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.9.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Finally, the latex-soaked gloves are heated in an Oven.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.10.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Hazmat Suit",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "A completed Hazmat suit provides immunity from every hazard, even radiation. It is made in an LV Assembler from Polyethylene and Polyvinyl Chloride. Fun fact! You can also look up #ppe_armor in JEI for more equipment that provides protection from hazardous materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.11.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "In case you do get heavily exposed to a hazard, there are some Medicines that can help you recover. Basic Pills are the most primitive and easy to make, but most come with Negative Side Effects. Tablets and Salvos are more effective and have less side effects, but they require LV equipment and more advanced resources to make.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.12.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The RadAwayᵗᵐ pill",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "This is The Ultimate cure for ALL the hazards and the ONLY effective cure to Radiation. However, it is also the most Expensive and Difficult to make, requiring HV tier equipment and advanced materials.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.13.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "If all else fails, bringing along a bed to respawn is a good idea. If you don't have access to Wool or String, you can also make a Thatch Bed.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.14.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Arsenicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Arsenic from its dust, vapor or Realgar. It slowly increases hunger, followed by nausea, and eventually death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Arsenicosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.15.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Asbestosis is an illness caused by inhaling Asbestos dust. If carried for long enough, it causes hunger. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Asbestosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.16.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Berylliosis is an illness caused by skin contact with Beryllium dust or Liquid Beryllium. At first it might seem that it doesn't do much. However, the longer the exposure, the faster it kills you. Gloves and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Berylliosis.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.17.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carbon Monoxide poisoning is an illness caused by inhaling Carbon Monoxide gas. Prolonged exposure causes nausea and quick death. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from Carbon Monoxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.18.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Carcinogens are substances that cause Cancer. They include Chromium Dust aswell as some organic compounds, such as Benzene and its products. Carcinogens don't go away on their own, but they give plenty of warnings before doing any real harm. It starts off with Weakness, followed by Hunger, then Slowness and later on Mining Fatique. Only when substantial enough exposure is accumulated it causes Death.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.19.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "The Face Mask protects from inhalation of harmful chemicals, while the Gloves protect from contact with Chromium Dust. The Hazmat Suit protects from both. In case of severe exposure, it is advised to take some Medicines to Prevent any possible damage.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.20.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Chemical burns are caused by inhalation or skin contact with certain Gases, Acids, Bases or Dusts. Exposure causes Weakness. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from everything.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.21.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Irritation is caused by inhalation of Ammonium Formate or skin contact with Chromite Dust. Short contact only causes Weakness, but if ignored for longer it starts Damaging Randomly. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from both.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.22.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Methanol poisoning is caused by inhalation of Methanol. It causes a strong Blindness effect. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protects from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.23.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Nauseating chemicals, such as Butyraldehyde, are substances that cause Nausea when inhaled. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit protect from inhalation.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.24.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Poisonous materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "There are two types of Poisonous materials. Weak include Lead Dust, while the stronger poisons include Nitrogen Dioxide. Weak poisons cause a Progressively Worsening Poison effect, while Regular poisons cause Weakness and a Stronger Poison effect. The Face Mask protects from inhalation, while the Gloves protects from direct skin contact. The Hazmat Suit protects from any contact.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.25.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Most Radioactive substances like Uranium 238 you will only meet at EV tier or above. They will Permanently Irradiate you. Small exposure causes glowing, but prolonged contact triggers a quick Death. We know it looks tasty and has a billion calories, but PLEASE DO NOT EAT URANIUM!",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.26.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Radioactive materials",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.title",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Only the Hazmat Suit, as well as some advanced armors provide full protection from radiation. In the case you do get irradiated, only the RadAwayᵗᵐ pill can cure you.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.27.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
        {
          "kind": "guide_page",
          "id": "tfc:field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards",
          "source": "file:minecraft/kubejs/assets/tfc/patchouli_books/field_guide/en_us/entries/tfg_ores/hazards.json",
          "text": "Silicosis is an illness caused by inhaling Silicon Dioxide Dust. Exposure causes a Reduction in both Health and the Air Supply you have while diving Under Water. The Face Mask and the Hazmat Suit provide protection from inhalation of silicon dioxide.",
          "key": "guide-page:pages.28.text",
          "label": "Hazardous Materials",
          "item_ref_count": 28,
          "recipe_ref_count": 3,
          "count": 29
        },
